F03 verified locally with real loopback mTLS: TLS 1.3-only guard with mandatory client verification, operator fingerprint-to-sensor scope mapping, locally delivered signed CRL failing closed when stale, typed verdicts on captured real handshakes, revoked identity replay denied before side effects, and 15 invalid configuration rows rejected. Revocation membership follows RFC 5280 (issuer, serial): chains are restricted to [leaf, authority anchor], the authority is the configured anchor that signed the single CRL, uncovered issuers fail closed with typed ErrUntrusted, and issuer-bound membership never applies another issuer's serials. No HTTP/CLI surface, certificate issuance, OCSP, remote Actions or product readiness certified.

F04 verified locally: internal signed versioned desired state with a strict typed document, an Ed25519 signature over the exact payload bytes using a local operator key that is independent from the mTLS CA and CRL material, a monotonic per-sensor revision and typed rejections for unsigned, wrongly signed, tampered, re-serialized, expired, not-yet-valid, stale and conflicting documents. No rejection replaces the active configuration. Owner review round one on a444f05 is resolved: the active state owns its own payload copy, the verification key is copied at construction, the validity window is rechecked under the state lock at acceptance time, and the accepted range of the settings is explicit deployment policy instead of a hard-coded product limit. The owner follow-up review of 2a2d15c is also resolved: the evidence and handoff state the proposed-policy status of the event-count ceilings, and a document whose event batch exceeds its spool is rejected as internally inconsistent. The active configuration is process state: the durable applied revision and the crash convergence of an apply belong to C11. No HTTP/CLI/UI surface, no key generation/storage/rotation/recovery, no key material in the repository or fixtures, no network service, no remote Actions or product readiness certified.
